# Script starter

A small translated native menu and a saved counter.

1. Open main.lua and read the comments addressed to modders.
2. Change the words in locales/en.json. Keep the stable keys and placeholders.
3. Use Validate, then Test. The project starts disabled and Test has separate progress.
4. Open Options > Extras > Mods in the game to use the page.
5. Use Export to make an installable ZIP with your creator credit.

To let others translate this mod, keep default_locale and locales in mod.json.
In Modkit choose File > New language pack, select this mod and enter the new
language and translator credit. Exported language packs contain only translated
strings; missing entries fall back to the original.

This is a starting point using public named APIs. It does not require editing
recompiled functions, changing game addresses or replacing original archives.

-- Modders: start here. Change the words in locales/en.json and the action
-- below; the menu stays inside the game's native Options > Extras > Mods.
-- Stable text keys let other people translate this project without editing Lua.
local function page()
    game.ui.register_page({id = "starter", title = game.locale.text("title"), rows = {
        {id = "status", type = "text", label = game.locale.text("count", {count = game.state.count or 0})},
        {id = "hello", label = game.locale.text("action")}
    }})
end

local function restored()
    -- State is replaced on reload/restore. Read game.state each time instead
    -- of keeping a reference to an old table or any temporary game handle.
    local count = game.state.count
    if type(count) ~= "number" or count ~= count or count < 0 or count > 1000000 then
        game.state.count = 0
    end
    page()
end

game.on("initialize", restored)
game.on("state.loaded", restored)
game.on("code.reloaded", page)
game.on("ui.action", function(event)
    if event.page ~= "starter" or event.row ~= "hello" then return end
    game.state.count = (game.state.count or 0) + 1
    game.log.info(game.locale.text("message"))
    page()
end)

-- Modders: logical players are 0/1, not positions in the family list.
-- This menu action affects the player who presses it. Requery the controlled
-- character on every action: switching characters can leave the old one as AI.
local cooldowns = {0, 0}
local shortcuts = false

local function page()
    game.ui.register_page({id = "player-actions", title = game.locale.text("title"), rows = {
        {id = "heal", label = game.locale.text("heal")},
        {id = "shortcuts", type = "toggle", label = game.locale.text("shortcuts"), value = shortcuts}
    }})
end

local function heal(player)
    if player ~= 0 and player ~= 1 then return end
    if cooldowns[player + 1] > 0 then return end
    local actor = game.players.controlled(player)
    if not actor then
        game.log.info(game.locale.text("no_actor"))
        return
    end
    -- Replace this call with another documented operation for your ability.
    -- The original health service preserves death rules; this isn't a revive.
    game.players.refill_health(actor.id)
    cooldowns[player + 1] = 5
end

game.on("initialize", page)
game.on("code.reloaded", page)
game.on("ui.action", function(event)
    if event.page ~= "player-actions" then return end
    if event.row == "heal" then heal(event.player or 0) end
    if event.row == "shortcuts" then shortcuts = event.value; page() end
end)
game.on("simulation", function(event)
    -- Simulation time stops while paused; display FPS doesn't alter cooldowns.
    for player = 0, 1 do
        cooldowns[player + 1] = math.max(0, cooldowns[player + 1] - event.seconds)
        if shortcuts then
            local input = game.input.state(player)
            -- The shortcut is off by default. Reading controls doesn't consume
            -- their original actions: pick an appropriate combo for your mod.
            if input.sampled and input.available and input.buttons.left_shoulder and input.pressed.y then
                heal(player)
            end
        end
    end
end)
game.on("level.unloading", function() cooldowns = {0, 0} end)

-- Modders: use simulation timers instead of counting rendered frames.
-- Timers belong to this mod, pause with gameplay and retire with the instance.
-- The host preserves their remaining time during code reload and mod saves.
local function page()
    game.ui.register_page({id = "timers", title = game.locale.text("title"), rows = {
        {id = "start", label = game.locale.text("start")},
        {id = "cancel", label = game.locale.text("cancel")},
        {id = "count", type = "text", label = game.locale.text("count", {count = game.state.completed or 0})}
    }})
end

local function restored()
    local count = game.state.completed
    if type(count) ~= "number" or count ~= count or count < 0 or count > 1000000 then
        game.state.completed = 0
    end
    -- Don't reschedule here: restored timers already have their own deadlines.
    page()
end

game.on("initialize", restored)
game.on("state.loaded", restored)
game.on("code.reloaded", page)
game.on("ui.action", function(event)
    if event.page ~= "timers" then return end
    if event.row == "start" then
        -- Reusing this id replaces the pending timer; it doesn't stack copies.
        game.timers.schedule("reminder", 5)
    elseif event.row == "cancel" then
        game.timers.cancel("reminder")
    end
end)
game.on("timer", function(event)
    if event.id ~= "reminder" then return end
    game.state.completed = (game.state.completed or 0) + 1
    game.log.info(game.locale.text("finished"))
    -- Put a supported game operation here for a delayed gameplay action.
    page()
end)

-- Put playthrough values in game.state so loading a save restores them. Do not
-- hold a local reference to game.state: the host replaces it when restoring.

    game.log.info(game.locale.text("level.ready", {visits = game.state.visits}))
    if game.state.protected then game.players.god_mode(true) end

-- Modders: this project runs through public APIs on every supported host.
-- It creates an authored mission beside the campaign, without editing the
-- campaign's scripts, objectives or save files. Start it in Options -> Mods.
local id = "there-and-back"
local sample_seconds = 0

local function text(key, values)
    return game.locale.text(key, values or {})
end

local function page()
    local mission = game.missions.get(id)
    local rows = {
        {id = "status", label = text("page.state", {
            state = text("status." .. mission.status)
        }), type = "text"}
    }
    for _, objective in ipairs(mission.objectives) do
        rows[#rows + 1] = {
            id = objective.id,
            type = "text",
            label = text("page.progress", {
                title = objective.title,
                progress = math.floor(objective.progress),
                goal = objective.goal
            })
        }
    end
    if mission.reason ~= "" then
        rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "reason", label = mission.reason, type = "text"}
    end
    rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "start", label = text(
        mission.status == "idle" and "page.start" or "page.replay"
    )}
    if mission.status ~= "idle" and mission.has_checkpoint then
        rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "retry", label = text("page.retry")}
    end
    if mission.status == "active" then
        rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "checkpoint", label = text("page.checkpoint")}
    end
    game.ui.register_page({id = "route", title = text("page.title"), rows = rows})
end

game.on("initialize", function()
    -- Stable objective ids belong in saves. Display text can be translated
    -- or reordered without invalidating progress. Goals/prerequisites need
    -- a state.loaded migration when an existing project changes them.
    game.missions.register({
        id = id, title = text("mission.title"),
        description = text("mission.description"),
        objectives = {
            {id = "outbound", title = text("objective.outbound"), goal = 12},
            {id = "return", title = text("objective.return"), requires = {"outbound"}}
        }
    })
    game.state.elapsed = 0
    game.state.checkpoint_elapsed = 0
    game.state.travellers = {}
    page()
end)

game.on("ui.action", function(event)
    if event.page ~= "route" then return end
    local players = game.players.list()
    if #players == 0 then
        game.log.info(text("error.no_level"))
        return
    end
    if event.row == "start" then
        -- Store coordinates, not a player handle: handles expire on restore.
        game.state.origins = {}
        for _, player in ipairs(players) do
            game.state.origins[player.character] = player.position
        end
        game.state.elapsed, game.state.checkpoint_elapsed = 0, 0
        game.state.travellers = {}
        if game.missions.get(id).status == "idle" then
            game.missions.start(id)
        else
            game.missions.restart(id, false)
        end
    elseif event.row == "retry" then
        -- This restores objective progress only. A larger mission should
        -- also restore its owned objects through supported world APIs.
        game.missions.restart(id)
        game.state.elapsed = game.state.checkpoint_elapsed or 0
    elseif event.row == "checkpoint" then
        game.missions.checkpoint(id)
        game.state.checkpoint_elapsed = game.state.elapsed
    end
    page()
end)

game.on("simulation", function(event)
    local mission = game.missions.get(id)
    if mission.status ~= "active" then return end
    -- Simulation seconds pause with the game and do not depend on display FPS.
    game.state.elapsed = game.state.elapsed + event.seconds
    sample_seconds = sample_seconds + event.seconds
    if sample_seconds < 0.1 then return end
    sample_seconds = 0
    if game.state.elapsed >= 90 then
        game.missions.fail(id, text("error.timeout"))
        return
    end
    local players = game.players.list()
    if #players == 0 then return end
    local alive = false
    local nearest_return, farthest = math.huge, 0
    local outward = mission.objectives[1]
    for _, player in ipairs(players) do
        alive = alive or player.max_health <= 0 or player.health > 0
        local p = player.position
        -- Each member starts from their own position. An inactive character
        -- already far from the first player must not advance the route.
        local origin = game.state.origins[player.character]
        if not origin then
            origin = p
            game.state.origins[player.character] = origin
        end
        local dx, dy, dz = p.x - origin.x, p.y - origin.y, p.z - origin.z
        local distance = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
        farthest = math.max(farthest, distance)
        -- players.list enumerates loaded family entities, not logical input
        -- assignments. An idle member waiting at home must not complete the
        -- return stage for somebody else. Track members who actually went out.
        if distance >= outward.goal then
            game.state.travellers[player.character] = true
        end
        if game.state.travellers[player.character] then
            nearest_return = math.min(nearest_return, distance)
        end
    end
    if not alive then
        game.missions.fail(id, text("error.health"))
        return
    end
    if outward.state == "active" and farthest > outward.progress then
        mission = game.missions.advance(id, "outbound",
            math.min(outward.goal, farthest) - outward.progress)
        if mission.objectives[1].state == "completed" then
            game.missions.checkpoint(id)
            game.state.checkpoint_elapsed = game.state.elapsed
        end
    end
    -- Co-op: either live family member may advance the route. One player
    -- remaining at the origin cannot finish both stages in the same sample.
    if outward.state == "completed" and nearest_return <= 2 then
        game.missions.advance(id, "return", 1)
    end
end)

game.on("mission.changed", function(event)
    if event.mission.id ~= id then return end
    page()
    game.log.info(text("log.change", {
        title = event.mission.title, state = text("status." .. event.mission.status)
    }))
end)

game.on("level.unloading", function()
    if game.missions.get(id).status == "active" then
        game.missions.fail(id, text("error.level"))
    end
end)
game.on("level.ready", page)
game.on("save.restored", page)
game.on("code.reloaded", page)
game.on("state.loaded", function(event)
    -- The host restores unchanged mission definitions after this callback.
    -- To change a goal, migrate event.missions and call missions.restore
    -- here. An invalid migration keeps the current running mod untouched.
    sample_seconds = 0
    game.state.travellers = game.state.travellers or {}
    assert(type(game.state.travellers) == "table", "Saved route participants are invalid")
    if game.state.elapsed ~= nil then
        assert(type(game.state.elapsed) == "number" and game.state.elapsed >= 0,
            "Saved mission time is invalid")
    end
    for _, saved in ipairs(event.missions.missions) do
        if saved.definition.id == id and saved.status ~= "idle" then
            assert(type(game.state.origins) == "table", "Saved route origins are invalid")
            for _, origin in pairs(game.state.origins) do
                assert(type(origin) == "table" and type(origin.x) == "number"
                    and type(origin.y) == "number" and type(origin.z) == "number",
                    "Saved route origin is invalid")
            end
        end
    end
end)

# Mission editor

Modders: create this project through **File → New project → Mission editor** in Modkit or
the creator CLI's `--template mission-editor` option. Creation includes the
shared Scene editor as scene.lua; copying this example folder alone does not.
Your project starts disabled, with the creator credit you entered.

Choose **Test**, load a level and open **Options → Extras → Mods → Mission
editor**. Add objectives at your character, choose reach, continuous stay or
wait rules, and set prerequisites, optional goals and retry points. Stop the
preview before editing. The Scene editor page in the same project places props
and supports movement, rotation, scaling and undo/redo.

Choose **Save mission and scene drafts** and wait for confirmation. Close Test,
then choose **Apply saved drafts** in Modkit. Both documents are applied
together after checking the project fingerprint. **Mission settings** edits
names, descriptions and rules without writing Lua. Save those edits before
testing again. Validate, Test and Export ZIP when ready; importing preserves
your credit and leaves the package disabled.

Read the source comments before extending the rules. Only the living family
members controlled by logical P1/P2 count toward visits; idle AI characters do
not. A stay must be continuous for the same player. Clocks use simulation time
and stop while paused. Retry restores objective progress and editor clocks;
it does not rewind the world. Exact saves separately retain supported objects
and mission state.

This is a one-episode route and prop editor, with at most 32 objectives and
64 props. It does not replace campaign progression, provide a mission HUD,
create NPC encounters, or author maps, collision or navigation. See the
[mission editor guide](https://github.com/YesterMester/TheSimpsonsGameRecomp/blob/main/modkit/MISSION_EDITOR.md)
for the document format and full workflow.

-- Modders: build routes in the original Options menu, then edit their names
-- and rules in the launcher's Mission settings. The scene editor is the same
-- public example, included as a frozen Lua module instead of a second copy
-- of its implementation. Both documents export in one credited package.
require("scene")

local id = "authored-mission"
local selected, prerequisite, step = nil, "", 1
local undo, redo, ticks, page_dirty = {}, {}, 0, false
local saving, pending_start, message, last_message = false, false, "Add an objective in a loaded level", nil
local page, start, synchronize

local function copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local result = {}; for k, v in pairs(value) do result[k] = copy(v) end
    return result
end
local function caption(value, limit)
    if utf8.len(value) <= limit then return value end
    return string.sub(value, 1, utf8.offset(value, limit - 2) - 1) .. "..."
end
local function doc() return game.state.mission_document end
local function index_of(key)
    for i, value in ipairs(doc().objectives) do if value.id == key then return i end end
end
local function item() local i = index_of(selected); return i and doc().objectives[i], i end
local function mission()
    local result = game.system.try_call("missions.get", {id = id})
    return result.ok and result.value or nil
end
local function failure(result)
    message = result.error or "The operation could not finish"
    game.log.info((result.code or "mission") .. ": " .. message)
end
local function definition(document)
    local result = {id = id, title = document.name, description = document.description,
        revision = document.revision, objectives = {}}
    for _, value in ipairs(document.objectives) do
        result.objectives[#result.objectives + 1] = {id = value.id, title = value.title,
            goal = value.kind == "reach" and 1 or value.seconds, requires = value.requires, optional = value.optional}
    end
    return result
end
synchronize = function()
    if #doc().objectives > 0 then game.missions.register(definition(doc()))
    else game.missions.remove(id) end
end
local function editable()
    if game.state.preview then message = "Stop preview before editing its rules"; return false end
    return true
end
local function world()
    local value = game.world.status()
    if not value.ready or value.level_root == "" then message = "Load a known episode first"; return end
    if #doc().objectives > 0 and value.level_root ~= doc().level_root then
        message = "Load " .. doc().level_root .. " to edit this route"; return
    end
    return value
end
local function record(before)
    undo[#undo + 1] = before; if #undo > 64 then table.remove(undo, 1) end
    redo = {}
end
local function apply(candidate, remember)
    local checked = game.system.try_call("projects.validate", {kind = "mission", document = candidate})
    if not checked.ok then failure(checked); return false end
    -- A preview is explicitly stopped before replacing its native contract.
    -- Document validation uses the same native objective graph rules first.
    game.missions.remove(id)
    if remember then record(copy(doc())) end
    game.state.mission_document = checked.value
    game.state.elapsed, game.state.holds = 0, {}
    game.state.sample_seconds = 0
    game.state.checkpoint_elapsed, game.state.checkpoint_holds = 0, {}
    synchronize()
    return true
end
local function edit(change)
    if not editable() then return end
    local candidate = copy(doc())
    if candidate.revision >= 4294967295 then message = "Mission revision limit reached"; return end
    candidate.revision = candidate.revision + 1
    change(candidate)
    if apply(candidate, true) then message = "Mission draft updated" end
end
local function next_id()
    repeat game.state.objective_sequence = game.state.objective_sequence + 1
    until not index_of("point-" .. game.state.objective_sequence)
    return "point-" .. game.state.objective_sequence
end
local function add(player, duplicate)
    if not editable() then return end
    local current = world(); if not current then return end
    if #doc().objectives >= 32 then message = "A route has at most 32 objectives"; return end
    local actor = game.players.controlled(player)
    if not actor then message = "Assign a controller to a family member"; return end
    local original = item()
    local value = duplicate and original and copy(original) or {kind = "reach", position = copy(actor.position),
        radius = 3, seconds = 2, optional = false, checkpoint = false, requires = {}}
    value.id = next_id(); value.title = "Checkpoint " .. game.state.objective_sequence
    if original then value.requires = {original.id} end
    if duplicate then value.position.x = value.position.x + math.max(step, value.radius * 2 + 1) end
    edit(function(candidate)
        candidate.level_root = current.level_root
        candidate.objectives[#candidate.objectives + 1] = value
    end)
    if index_of(value.id) then selected = value.id end
end
local function scene_ready()
    local scene = game.state.scene
    if not scene or not scene.autoload or #scene.objects == 0 or scene.level_root ~= doc().level_root then return true end
    local tags = {}
    for _, value in ipairs(game.world.owned()) do tags[value.tag] = true end
    for _, value in ipairs(scene.objects) do if not tags[value.id] then return false end end
    return true
end
start = function(retry)
    if not world() then return false end
    if #doc().objectives == 0 then message = "Add an objective first"; return false end
    if not scene_ready() then message = "Wait for the scene preview to load"; return false end
    synchronize()
    local current = mission()
    if current.status == "idle" then game.missions.start(id)
    else game.missions.restart(id, retry == true) end
    game.state.preview = true
    game.state.elapsed = retry and current.has_checkpoint and game.state.checkpoint_elapsed or 0
    game.state.holds = retry and current.has_checkpoint and copy(game.state.checkpoint_holds) or {}
    if not (retry and current.has_checkpoint) then game.state.checkpoint_elapsed, game.state.checkpoint_holds = 0, {} end
    game.state.sample_seconds, pending_start = 0, false
    message = retry and "Preview retried" or "Preview started"
    return true
end
local function checkpoint()
    game.missions.checkpoint(id)
    game.state.checkpoint_elapsed = game.state.elapsed
    game.state.checkpoint_holds = copy(game.state.holds)
end
local function stop()
    game.missions.remove(id)
    game.state.preview, pending_start, game.state.sample_seconds = false, false, 0
    game.state.elapsed, game.state.holds = 0, {}
    game.state.checkpoint_elapsed, game.state.checkpoint_holds = 0, {}
    synchronize()
    message = "Preview stopped; edit the mission"
end
page = function()
    if not doc() then return end
    page_dirty = false
    if not index_of(selected) then selected = doc().objectives[1] and doc().objectives[1].id end
    local choices, parents = {}, {{label = "None", value = ""}}
    for i, value in ipairs(doc().objectives) do
        local label = i .. ": " .. caption(value.title, 20)
        choices[#choices + 1] = {label = label, value = value.id}
        if value.id ~= selected then parents[#parents + 1] = {label = label, value = value.id} end
    end
    if #choices == 0 then choices = {{label = "Add an objective", value = ""}} end
    if not index_of(prerequisite) or prerequisite == selected then prerequisite = "" end
    local current, objective = mission(), item()
    local rows = {
        {id = "summary", type = "text", label = #doc().objectives .. "/32 objectives; " .. (current and current.status or "authoring")},
        {id = "episode", type = "text", label = doc().level_root ~= "" and caption(doc().level_root, 32) or "Add a point to choose an episode"},
        {id = "add", label = "Add objective at my character"},
        {id = "objective", type = "select", label = "Objective", choices = choices, value = selected or ""},
        {id = "step", type = "select", label = "Movement step", value = step,
            choices = {{label = "0.1", value = .1}, {label = "1", value = 1}, {label = "5", value = 5}, {label = "10", value = 10}}}
    }
    if objective then
        rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "kind", type = "select", label = "Rule", value = objective.kind, choices = {
            {label = "Reach point", value = "reach"}, {label = "Stay at point", value = "stay"}, {label = "Wait", value = "wait"}}}
        if objective.kind ~= "wait" then
            rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "stamp", label = "Move point to my character"}
            for _, axis in ipairs({"x", "y", "z"}) do rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "position-" .. axis, type = "slider",
                label = "Point " .. string.upper(axis), value = objective.position[axis], min = -1000000, max = 1000000, step = step} end
            rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "radius", type = "slider", label = "Radius", value = objective.radius, min = .1, max = 1000, step = .5}
        end
        if objective.kind ~= "reach" then rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "seconds", type = "slider", label = "Seconds",
            value = objective.seconds, min = .1, max = 86400, step = .5} end
        rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "parent", type = "select", label = "Prerequisite", choices = parents, value = prerequisite}
        rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "link", label = "Add or remove prerequisite"}
        rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "links", type = "text", label = caption("Needs: " .. (#objective.requires == 0 and "none" or table.concat(objective.requires, ", ")), 32)}
        rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "optional", type = "toggle", label = "Optional", value = objective.optional}
        rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "retry-point", type = "toggle", label = "Retry point after completion", value = objective.checkpoint}
        for _, row in ipairs({{id = "duplicate", label = "Duplicate objective"}, {id = "remove", label = "Remove objective"},
            {id = "up", label = "Move objective up"}, {id = "down", label = "Move objective down"}}) do rows[#rows + 1] = row end
        if current then
            for _, value in ipairs(current.objectives) do if value.id == selected then
                local hold = game.state.holds[value.id]
                rows[#rows + 1] = {id = "progress", type = "text", label = caption(value.state .. ": " .. string.format("%.1f/%.1f", hold and hold.seconds or value.progress, value.goal), 32)}
            end end
        end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs({
        {id = "undo", label = "Undo (" .. #undo .. ")"}, {id = "redo", label = "Redo (" .. #redo .. ")"},
        {id = "time-limit", type = "slider", label = "Time limit (0 is off)", value = doc().time_limit, min = 0, max = 86400, step = 5},
        {id = "defeat", type = "toggle", label = "Fail when all players fall", value = doc().fail_on_defeat},
        {id = "auto", type = "toggle", label = "Start on episode entry", value = doc().auto_start},
        {id = "start", label = "Play from beginning"}, {id = "retry", label = "Retry preview checkpoint"},
        {id = "checkpoint", label = "Set preview checkpoint"}, {id = "fail", label = "Fail preview"},
        {id = "stop", label = "Stop preview and edit"}, {id = "save", label = "Save mission and scene drafts"},
        {id = "new", label = "New empty mission"}, {id = "status", type = "text", label = caption(message, 32)}
    }) do rows[#rows + 1] = row end
    if message ~= last_message then game.log.info(message); last_message = message end
    game.ui.register_page({id = "mission", title = "Mission editor", rows = rows})
end
local function state_loaded()
    game.state.mission_document = game.projects.validate("mission", doc())
    local function bounded(value, high)
        return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value <= high
    end
    assert(type(game.state.preview) == "boolean" and bounded(game.state.elapsed, 1e12)
        and bounded(game.state.checkpoint_elapsed, 1e12) and bounded(game.state.sample_seconds, .1)
        and bounded(game.state.objective_sequence, 1e9) and game.state.objective_sequence % 1 == 0,
        "Saved mission editor clocks or sequence are invalid")
    for _, holds in ipairs({game.state.holds, game.state.checkpoint_holds}) do
        assert(type(holds) == "table", "Saved mission hold state is invalid")
        local count = 0
        for key, hold in pairs(holds) do
            count = count + 1
            local index = index_of(key)
            assert(count <= 32 and index and doc().objectives[index].kind == "stay"
                and type(hold) == "table" and (hold.player == 0 or hold.player == 1)
                and bounded(hold.seconds, doc().objectives[index].seconds), "Saved mission hold ownership is invalid")
        end
    end
    -- Recreate definitions before the host restores objective progress. Do
    -- not reset elapsed time, hold ownership or the saved retry point here.
    synchronize()
    undo, redo, pending_start = {}, {}, false
    page()
end
game.on("initialize", function()
    local frozen = game.projects.document("mission")
    local draft = game.storage.read("mission-draft.json")
    game.state.mission_document = draft and draft.fingerprint == frozen.fingerprint and draft.mission or frozen.document
    game.state.preview, game.state.elapsed, game.state.holds = false, 0, {}
    game.state.sample_seconds = 0
    game.state.checkpoint_elapsed, game.state.checkpoint_holds, game.state.objective_sequence = 0, {}, 0
    state_loaded()
end)
game.on("state.loaded", state_loaded)
game.on("code.reloaded", function() message = "Mission progress rebound after reload"; page() end)
game.on("save.restored", function() message = "Mission and retry point restored"; page() end)
game.on("level.ready", function()
    if doc().auto_start and #doc().objectives > 0 and game.world.status().level_root == doc().level_root then
        local current = mission(); pending_start = not current or current.status == "idle"
    end
    page()
end)
game.on("level.unloading", function()
    game.state.sample_seconds, pending_start = 0, false
    local current = mission()
    if game.state.preview and current and current.status == "active" then game.missions.fail(id, "Left the mission's episode") end
end)
game.on("mission.changed", function() page_dirty = true end)
game.on("frame", function()
    ticks = ticks + 1
    if ticks % 15 ~= 0 then return end
    if pending_start and scene_ready() then start(false); page() end
    if saving and game.storage.status().pending == 0 then
        saving = false
        message = #game.storage.status().errors == 0 and "Drafts saved; close Test, then Apply saved drafts" or "Draft write failed; check storage errors"
        page()
    end
    if page_dirty then page() end
end)
game.on("simulation", function(event)
    if not game.state.preview then return end
    local current = mission()
    if not current or current.status ~= "active" then return end
    local status = game.world.status()
    if not status.ready or status.level_root ~= doc().level_root then return end
    -- Simulation seconds pause with the game. Only logical P1/P2 controllers
    -- count: an AI family member waiting at a point cannot complete it.
    game.state.sample_seconds = game.state.sample_seconds + event.seconds
    if game.state.sample_seconds < .1 then return end
    local delta = game.state.sample_seconds; game.state.sample_seconds = 0
    local actors, any_alive, count = {}, false, 0
    for player = 0, 1 do
        local actor = game.players.controlled(player)
        if actor then
            count = count + 1
            if actor.max_health <= 0 or actor.health > 0 then actors[#actors + 1] = {player = player, actor = actor}; any_alive = true end
        end
    end
    if doc().fail_on_defeat and count > 0 and not any_alive then game.missions.fail(id, "All controlled players fell"); return end
    if #actors == 0 then return end
    game.state.elapsed = game.state.elapsed + delta
    if doc().time_limit > 0 and game.state.elapsed >= doc().time_limit then game.missions.fail(id, "Time limit reached"); return end
    -- Snapshot availability before processing. A newly unlocked point is
    -- evaluated on the next sample, not completed by the same visit twice.
    local updates, retry_points = {}, {}
    for i, objective in ipairs(doc().objectives) do
        local progress = current.objectives[i]
        if progress.state == "active" then
            local amount = 0
            if objective.kind == "wait" then amount = delta
            else
                local inside = {}
                for _, value in ipairs(actors) do
                    local p, target = value.actor.position, objective.position
                    local dx, dy, dz = p.x - target.x, p.y - target.y, p.z - target.z
                    if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= objective.radius * objective.radius then inside[value.player] = true end
                end
                if objective.kind == "reach" then
                    if inside[0] or inside[1] then amount = 1 end
                else
                    local hold = game.state.holds[objective.id]
                    if not hold or not inside[hold.player] then
                        local player = inside[0] and 0 or inside[1] and 1
                        hold = player and {player = player, seconds = 0} or nil
                    end
                    if hold then
                        hold.seconds = math.min(objective.seconds, hold.seconds + delta)
                        if hold.seconds >= objective.seconds then amount = objective.seconds; hold = nil end
                    end
                    game.state.holds[objective.id] = hold
                end
            end
            if amount > 0 then
                updates[#updates + 1] = {objective = objective.id, amount = amount}
                if objective.checkpoint then retry_points[objective.id] = true end
            end
        end
    end
    -- One native transaction validates every update before committing and
    -- returns one snapshot, rather than copying all objectives 32 times.
    if #updates > 0 then
        local result = game.missions.advance_batch(id, updates)
        if result.status == "active" then
            for _, value in ipairs(result.objectives) do
                if retry_points[value.id] and value.state == "completed" then checkpoint(); break end
            end
        end
    end
    page_dirty = true
end)
game.on("ui.action", function(event)
    if event.page ~= "mission" then return end
    if event.row == "objective" then selected = event.value; page(); return end
    if event.row == "parent" then prerequisite = event.value; page(); return end
    if event.row == "step" then step = event.value; page(); return end
    if event.row == "save" then
        local result = game.system.try_call("projects.save_all", {documents = {mission = doc(), scene = game.state.scene}})
        if result.ok then
            saving = true; message = "Saving mission and scene drafts"
        else failure(result) end
    elseif event.row == "start" or event.row == "retry" then start(event.row == "retry")
    elseif event.row == "stop" then stop()
    elseif event.row == "checkpoint" or event.row == "fail" then
        local current = mission()
        if current and current.status == "active" then
            if event.row == "checkpoint" then checkpoint(); message = "Preview checkpoint recorded"
            else game.missions.fail(id, "Failed from the mission editor") end
        else message = "Start a preview first" end
    elseif editable() then
        local objective, index = item()
        if event.row == "add" then add(event.player, false)
        elseif event.row == "duplicate" then add(event.player, true)
        elseif event.row == "new" then
            local empty = game.projects.document("mission").document
            empty.objectives, empty.level_root, empty.auto_start = {}, "", false
            if apply(empty, true) then selected = nil; message = "New empty mission" end
        elseif event.row == "undo" or event.row == "redo" then
            local from, to = event.row == "undo" and undo or redo, event.row == "undo" and redo or undo
            local target = from[#from]
            if target then
                local previous = copy(doc())
                if apply(target, false) then table.remove(from); to[#to + 1] = previous; message = "Mission edit restored" end
            end
        elseif event.row == "time-limit" or event.row == "defeat" or event.row == "auto" then
            edit(function(value) value[event.row == "time-limit" and "time_limit" or event.row == "defeat" and "fail_on_defeat" or "auto_start"] = event.value end)
        elseif objective then
            if event.row == "stamp" then
                local actor = game.players.controlled(event.player)
                if actor and world() then edit(function(value) value.objectives[index].position = copy(actor.position) end) end
            elseif event.row == "remove" then
                edit(function(value)
                    table.remove(value.objectives, index)
                    for _, other in ipairs(value.objectives) do
                        for i = #other.requires, 1, -1 do if other.requires[i] == objective.id then table.remove(other.requires, i) end end
                    end
                end)
            elseif event.row == "up" or event.row == "down" then
                local to = index + (event.row == "up" and -1 or 1)
                if to >= 1 and to <= #doc().objectives then edit(function(value) value.objectives[index], value.objectives[to] = value.objectives[to], value.objectives[index] end) end
            elseif event.row == "link" and prerequisite ~= "" then
                edit(function(value)
                    local deps, found = value.objectives[index].requires, false
                    for i = #deps, 1, -1 do if deps[i] == prerequisite then table.remove(deps, i); found = true end end
                    if not found then deps[#deps + 1] = prerequisite end
                end)
            elseif string.sub(event.row, 1, 9) == "position-" then
                edit(function(value) value.objectives[index].position[string.sub(event.row, 10)] = event.value end)
            elseif event.row == "kind" or event.row == "radius" or event.row == "seconds" or event.row == "optional" or event.row == "retry-point" then
                edit(function(value) value.objectives[index][event.row == "retry-point" and "checkpoint" or event.row] = event.value end)
            end
        end
    end
    page()
end)

-- Modders: this editor uses public operations only. A scene keeps original
-- definition GUIDs, native classes, source paths and world poses. Temporary
-- entity/template handles stay in local variables and never enter game.state.
-- New projects are disabled. Use the launcher's Test action, open this page
-- through Options > Extras > Mods, then Save draft before closing the game.
local templates, template_index, template_page = {}, 1, 1
local definitions = {}
local template_indices = {}
local selected, undo, redo, pending = nil, {}, {}, nil
local message, step, turn_step, scale_step = "Load a level and choose a prop", 1, 15, 1.1
local ticks, saving, bound, last_message = 0, false, 0, nil
local page, refresh, begin_load
local MAX_OBJECTS, PAGE_SIZE = 64, 40

-- The original TV menu has single-row labels. Keep UTF-8 names readable
-- without wrapping into its next button; documents retain the full identity.
local function caption(text, limit)
    if utf8.len(text) <= limit then return text end
    return string.sub(text, 1, utf8.offset(text, limit - 2) - 1) .. "..."
end

local function copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
    local result = {}
    for k, v in pairs(value) do result[k] = copy(v) end
    return result
end
local function document() return game.state.scene end
local function object_index(id)
    for i, item in ipairs(document().objects) do if item.id == id then return i end end
end
local function item() local i = object_index(selected); return i and document().objects[i], i end
local function tagged(id) return game.world.tagged(id) end
local function same_source(a, b)
    return a.guid == b.guid and a.class == b.class
end
local function template_for(source)
    -- Reuse the current refresh, rather than converting hundreds of native
    -- catalog records to Lua again for every placement, duplicate and undo.
    -- These handles remain local and are rebuilt after loads and restores.
    return definitions[source.guid .. ":" .. source.class] or nil
end
local function fail(result)
    message = result.error or "The native operation could not finish"
    game.log.info((result.code or "scene") .. ": " .. message)
end
local function validate(value)
    local result = game.system.try_call("scenes.validate", {document = value})
    if not result.ok then fail(result); return end
    return result.value
end
local function history(before, after, index)
    undo[#undo + 1] = {before = copy(before), after = copy(after), index = index}
    if #undo > 64 then table.remove(undo, 1) end
    redo = {}
end
local function live_count()
    bound = 0
    if not game.world.status().ready then return end
    for _, object in ipairs(game.world.owned()) do if object_index(object.tag) then bound = bound + 1 end end
end
local function current_level()
    local world = game.world.status()
    if not world.ready or world.level_root == "" then
        message = "Wait for a level with a known episode catalog"
        return
    end
    if #document().objects > 0 and document().level_root ~= world.level_root then
        message = "This scene belongs to " .. document().level_root .. "; load it or start a new scene"
        return
    end
    return world
end
local function create(object)
    local template = template_for(object.source)
    if not template then return {ok = false, error = "Load the scene's original source before recreating this prop"} end
    local result = game.system.try_call("world.spawn", {template = template.id,
        position = object.transform.position, radius = object.radius, tag = object.id})
    if not result.ok then return result end
    local entity = result.value
    result = game.system.try_call("entities.set_transform", {entity = entity, transform = object.transform})
    if not result.ok then game.world.destroy(entity); return result end
    return {ok = true, value = entity}
end
local function next_id()
    repeat
        game.state.sequence = (game.state.sequence or 0) + 1
    until not object_index("scene-" .. game.state.sequence)
    return "scene-" .. game.state.sequence
end
local function record(template, position)
    return {id = next_id(), name = template.name, radius = 1,
        source = {guid = template.source_guid, class = template.class, stream = template.source_stream},
        transform = {position = position, right = {x = 1, y = 0, z = 0},
            up = {x = 0, y = 1, z = 0}, forward = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 1}}}
end
local function add(object)
    if #document().objects >= MAX_OBJECTS then message = "This scene already has 64 objects"; return end
    local world = current_level(); if not world then return end
    local candidate = copy(document()); candidate.level_root = world.level_root
    candidate.objects[#candidate.objects + 1] = copy(object)
    candidate = validate(candidate); if not candidate then return end
    local result = create(object)
    if not result.ok then fail(result); return end
    game.state.scene = candidate; selected = object.id
    history(nil, object, #candidate.objects)
    message = "Placed " .. object.name
    live_count()
end
local function edit(change)
    local object, index = item(); if not object then message = "Select a scene object first"; return end
    local entity = tagged(object.id); if not entity then message = "Load this scene's preview first"; return end
    local result = game.system.try_call("entities.transform", {entity = entity})
    if not result.ok then fail(result); return end
    local before, after = copy(object), copy(object)
    before.transform = result.value; after.transform = copy(result.value)
    change(after.transform)
    local candidate = copy(document()); candidate.objects[index] = after
    candidate = validate(candidate); if not candidate then return end
    result = game.system.try_call("entities.set_transform", {entity = entity, transform = after.transform})
    if not result.ok then fail(result); return end
    game.state.scene = candidate; history(before, after, index)
    message = "Updated " .. object.name
end
local function apply_history(entry, reverse)
    local target
    if reverse then target = entry.before else target = entry.after end
    local old
    if reverse then old = entry.after else old = entry.before end
    local id = (target or old).id
    local existing = tagged(id)
    if target and old then
        if not existing then message = "This object is no longer in the preview"; return false end
        local result = game.system.try_call("entities.set_transform", {entity = existing, transform = target.transform})
        if not result.ok then fail(result); return false end
    elseif target then
        if existing then message = "This scene object already exists"; return false end
        local result = create(target)
        if not result.ok then fail(result); return false end
    elseif existing then game.world.destroy(existing) end
    local index = object_index(id)
    if target then
        if index then document().objects[index] = copy(target)
        else table.insert(document().objects, math.min(entry.index, #document().objects + 1), copy(target)) end
        selected = id
    elseif index then
        table.remove(document().objects, index)
        selected = document().objects[math.min(index, #document().objects)]
        selected = selected and selected.id
    end
    live_count()
    return true
end
local function unload()
    if pending then
        game.assets.cancel_source()
        pending = nil
    end
    for _, value in ipairs(game.world.owned()) do if object_index(value.tag) then game.world.destroy(value.id) end end
    game.assets.release_source()
    templates, definitions = {}, {}
    bound, undo, redo = 0, {}, {}
    message = "Preview unloaded; the authored scene is kept"
end
local function rollback(reason)
    for _, id in ipairs(pending.created) do
        local entity = tagged(id)
        if entity then game.world.destroy(entity) end
    end
    game.assets.cancel_source()
    templates, definitions = {}, {}
    pending = nil
    live_count()
    if bound == 0 then game.assets.release_source() end
    message = reason
end
begin_load = function()
    local world = current_level(); if not world then return end
    if #document().objects == 0 then message = "This scene is empty"; return end
    pending = {index = 1, created = {}, requested = nil}
    undo, redo = {}, {}
    message = "Loading scene objects and native resources"
end
refresh = function()
    templates, definitions, template_indices = {}, {}, {}
    if game.world.status().ready then
        for _, value in ipairs(game.world.catalog()) do

        -- storage replacement so neither editor can leave the other behind.

        if game.state.mission_document then
            result = game.system.try_call("projects.save_all", {documents = {scene = document(), mission = game.state.mission_document}})

    if event.row == "object" then selected = event.value; page(); return end

    if not game.world.status().ready then message = "Load a level first"; page(); return end

    elseif event.row == "previous-page" or event.row == "next-page" then
        local pages = math.max(1, math.ceil(#templates / PAGE_SIZE))
        template_page = (template_page - 1 + (event.row == "next-page" and 1 or -1)) % pages + 1
        template_index = (template_page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE + 1
    elseif event.row == "unload" then unload()
    elseif event.row == "new" then
        unload(); game.state.scene = game.scenes.document().document

        selected = nil; message = "New empty scene; Save draft replaces your previous draft"

        local source, target = event.row == "undo" and undo or redo, event.row == "undo" and redo or undo

            table.remove(source); target[#target + 1] = entry
            message = event.row == "undo" and "Edit undone" or "Edit reapplied"
        end

        local actor = game.players.controlled(event.player)
        if actor then edit(function(pose) local p = actor.position; pose.position = {x = p.x + 4, y = p.y + 1, z = p.z} end) end
    elseif string.sub(event.row, 1, 9) == "position-" then
        local axis = string.sub(event.row, 10)
        edit(function(pose) pose.position[axis] = event.value end)
    elseif event.row == "grow" or event.row == "shrink" or event.row == "turn-left" or event.row == "turn-right" then
        edit(function(pose)
            local angle = math.rad(event.row == "turn-left" and -turn_step or turn_step)
            local c, s = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
            for _, name in ipairs({"right", "up", "forward"}) do
                local v = pose[name]
                if event.row == "grow" or event.row == "shrink" then
                    local factor = event.row == "grow" and scale_step or 1 / scale_step
                    pose[name] = {x = v.x * factor, y = v.y * factor, z = v.z * factor}
                else pose[name] = {x = v.x * c + v.z * s, y = v.y, z = v.z * c - v.x * s} end
            end
        end)
    end
    page()
end)

-- Modders: logical players are 0 and 1. They are not indices into
-- players.list(), which includes the loaded family, including inactive actors.
-- players.controlled(player) finds the current human character. Requery it:
-- an old handle can remain alive as an AI after the player switches away.
-- These snapshots already include keyboard/controller/touch assignment and
-- the game's held-input guards. Reading never polls a driver or consumes input.
local recording = true
local counts, last = {0, 0}, {"none", "none"}
local characters = {"Unassigned", "Unassigned"}
local elapsed, dirty = 0, false
local controls = {
    "a", "b", "x", "y", "dpad_up", "dpad_down", "dpad_left", "dpad_right",
    "left_shoulder", "right_shoulder", "left_trigger", "right_trigger",
    "left_stick", "right_stick", "start", "back", "guide"
}

local function page()
    game.ui.register_page({id = "inputs", title = "Input observer", rows = {
        {id = "p1", type = "text", label = "P1 presses: " .. counts[1] .. "; last: " .. last[1]},
        {id = "p2", type = "text", label = "P2 presses: " .. counts[2] .. "; last: " .. last[2]},
        {id = "actor1", type = "text", label = "P1 character: " .. characters[1]},
        {id = "actor2", type = "text", label = "P2 character: " .. characters[2]},
        {id = "record", type = "toggle", label = "Record gameplay controls", value = recording},
        {id = "clear", label = "Clear counts"}
    }})
    dirty = false
end

game.on("initialize", page)

game.on("simulation", function(event)
    for player = 0, 1 do
        local actor = game.players.controlled(player)
        local name = actor and actor.character or "Unassigned"
        if characters[player + 1] ~= name then
            characters[player + 1] = name
            dirty = true
        end
        -- A custom ability could now affect actor.id, not an arbitrary member
        -- of players.list(). Do not store this handle in saved game.state.
    end
    -- A gameplay action belongs in simulation, not frame: pause/menu redraws
    -- must not activate it. Use ui.action for buttons in your native menu page.
    if recording then
        for player = 0, 1 do
            local input = game.input.state(player)
            if input.sampled and input.available then
                for _, control in ipairs(controls) do
                    if input.pressed[control] then
                        local index = player + 1 -- Lua arrays begin at 1.
                        counts[index] = counts[index] + 1
                        last[index] = control
                        dirty = true
                    end
                end
                -- For continuous actions, read input.buttons.x, for example.
                -- Analog axes are input.left_stick.x/y and right_stick.x/y,
                -- from -1 to 1 (up is positive Y); triggers range from 0 to 1.
                -- Do not save these transient controls or input edges in game.state.
            end
        end
    end
    -- Updating menu text does not need to run at the game's frame rate.
    elapsed = elapsed + event.seconds
    if dirty and elapsed >= 0.25 then
        elapsed = 0
        page()
    end
end)

game.on("ui.action", function(event)
    if event.page ~= "inputs" then return end
    -- event.player identifies the logical player who used this page, including
    -- P2. It does not change which controller the input service reads.
    if event.row == "record" then recording = event.value end
    if event.row == "clear" then counts, last = {0, 0}, {"none", "none"} end
    page()
end)

game.on("level.unloading", function()
    counts, last = {0, 0}, {"none", "none"}
    characters = {"Unassigned", "Unassigned"}
    elapsed = 0
    page()
end)

-- Modders: a catalog entry is a template already loaded by this level.
-- An asset search result is not a template and does not load dependencies.
-- This example lets you deliberately spawn a prop from its native menu page;
-- it never spawns automatically when a level, save or code reload begins.
local templates, selected, live, removed = {}, 1, 0, 0
local status = "Choose a loaded prop"

local function page()
    local choice = templates[selected]
    game.ui.register_page({id = "objects", title = "Owned objects", rows = {
        {id = "template", type = "text", label = "Template: " .. (choice and choice.name or "Load a level")},
        {id = "previous", label = "Previous loaded prop"},
        {id = "next", label = "Next loaded prop"},
        {id = "spawn", label = "Spawn beside my character"},
        {id = "move", label = "Bring my latest object here"},
        {id = "turn", label = "Rotate latest 15 degrees"},
        {id = "grow", label = "Grow latest by 10%"},
        {id = "shrink", label = "Shrink latest by 10%"},
        {id = "count", type = "text", label = "My objects: " .. live .. "; removed: " .. removed},
        {id = "status", type = "text", label = status},
        {id = "clear", label = "Remove my objects"}
    }})
end

local function refresh()
    templates = {}
    if not game.world.status().ready then live = 0; page(); return end
    for _, item in ipairs(game.world.catalog()) do
        -- Start with props. Other classes can have encounter, collectible or
        -- script requirements; the generic factory alone does not prove them.
        if item.category == "Props" then templates[#templates + 1] = item end
    end
    selected = math.max(1, math.min(selected, #templates))
    live = #game.world.owned()
    page()
end

game.on("initialize", page)
game.on("level.ready", refresh)
game.on("code.reloaded", refresh)
game.on("save.restored", refresh)
game.on("level.unloading", function()
    -- All of the old world's handles are stale. The game tears its objects
    -- down; do not call world.destroy on handles from the previous level.
    templates, selected, live = {}, 1, 0
    page()
end)

game.on("ui.action", function(event)
    if event.page ~= "objects" then return end
    if event.row == "previous" and #templates > 0 then
        selected = (selected - 2) % #templates + 1
    elseif event.row == "next" and #templates > 0 then
        selected = selected % #templates + 1
    elseif event.row == "spawn" then
        local actor = game.players.controlled(event.player)
        local template = templates[selected]
        if not actor or not template then return end
        local p = actor.position
        -- Coordinates use the game's X/Z ground plane and Y height. A real
        -- encounter should author placement, collision clearance and resources.
        -- A class can reject generic cloning. Handle an expected failure so
        -- trying an unsupported template does not retire our other objects.
        local result = game.system.try_call("world.spawn", {template = template.id,
            position = {x = p.x + 4, y = p.y + 1, z = p.z}, radius = 1})
        status = result.ok and "Spawned " .. template.name or "This template could not be cloned"
        if not result.ok then game.log.info(result.code .. ": " .. result.error) end
        live = #game.world.owned()
    elseif event.row == "move" then
        local actor = game.players.controlled(event.player)
        local objects = game.world.owned()
        local latest = objects[#objects]
        if not actor or not latest then return end
        local p = actor.position
        -- Read and move through typed world coordinates. The host converts
        -- parent space and runs the class setter, including its controller.
        -- This is placement, not a collision sweep: author safe destinations.
        -- system.try_call handles a named host failure, not an arbitrary Lua
        -- function. Callback errors and runaway scripts still stop this mod.
        local before = game.system.try_call("entities.transform", {entity = latest.id})
        local result = before
        if before.ok then
            result = game.system.try_call("entities.move", {entity = latest.id,
                position = {x = p.x + 4, y = p.y + 1, z = p.z}})
        end
        if result.ok then
            local old = before.value.position
            status = string.format("Moved from %.1f, %.1f, %.1f", old.x, old.y, old.z)
        else
            status = "This object's transform is unavailable"
            game.log.info(result.code .. ": " .. result.error)
        end
    elseif event.row == "turn" or event.row == "grow" or event.row == "shrink" then
        local objects = game.world.owned()
        local latest = objects[#objects]
        if not latest then return end
        local result = game.system.try_call("entities.transform", {entity = latest.id})
        if result.ok then
            local pose = result.value
            -- Modders: basis vectors include scale. Change every basis vector,
            -- leaving the world position alone. The native full setter updates
            -- its cached scale and notifies the model/controller; writing a
            -- frame's bytes yourself would skip that class behavior.
            local angle = math.rad(15)
            local c, s = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
            local factor = event.row == "grow" and 1.1 or 0.9
            for _, name in ipairs({"right", "up", "forward"}) do
                local v = pose[name]
                if event.row == "turn" then
                    -- Rotate around world Y, the game's vertical axis.
                    pose[name] = {x = v.x * c + v.z * s, y = v.y, z = v.z * c - v.x * s}
                else
                    pose[name] = {x = v.x * factor, y = v.y * factor, z = v.z * factor}
                end
            end
            result = game.system.try_call("entities.set_transform", {entity = latest.id, transform = pose})
        end
        status = result.ok and "Updated my object's orientation and scale" or "This transform could not be applied"
        if not result.ok then game.log.info(result.code .. ": " .. result.error) end
    elseif event.row == "clear" then
        for _, object in ipairs(game.world.owned()) do game.world.destroy(object.id) end
        -- A borrowed cross-level template automatically retains its source
        -- for this mod. Release that claim too; other owners keep theirs.
        game.assets.release_source()
        -- Removal is queued until this callback returns; it is already absent
        -- from world.owned(). Never free a guest address or call a destructor.
        live = #game.world.owned()
        status = "Removal requested"
    end
    page()
end)

game.on("entity.removed", function(event)
    -- event.entity has expired. An NPC, pickup or destructible can disappear
    -- through normal gameplay too. Observe the event, then query current IDs.
    removed = removed + 1
    live = #game.world.owned()
    page()
end)

-- Do not keep object handles in game.state. Code reload transfers live owned
-- objects to the replacement generation. Exact restore rebinds saved GUIDs;
-- a checkpoint loads a fresh world, so an authored mission must recreate its
-- intended objects from supported templates. Failures retire this owner and
-- its dependents; another mod's objects and the original level stay separate.

        {id = "previous", label = "Previous original variant"},
        {id = "next", label = "Next original variant"},
        {id = "load", label = "Load this variant's source"},
        {id = "cancel", label = "Cancel my pending source addition"},
        {id = "spawn", label = "Spawn beside my character"},
        {id = "status", type = "text", label = status},
        {id = "clear", label = "Remove my objects and release my sources"}
    }})
end

local function definitions()
    if not asset then return end
    variants = {}
    -- Page results in larger tools. This small example uses the first 100
    -- definitions of one model; each retains its original GUID and source.
    local result = game.assets.templates(asset.id, 0, 100)
    for _, item in ipairs(result.items) do
        if item.supported then variants[#variants + 1] = item end
    end
    selected = math.max(1, math.min(selected, #variants))
end

local function inspect()
    local result = game.assets.search(nil, nil, 0, 10, resource)
    if not result.ready then
        waiting = true
        status = "Indexing game files: " .. result.files .. "/" .. result.total_files
        page()
        return
    end
    waiting = false
    asset = result.items[1]
    definitions()
    status = asset and "Choose a variant, load its source, then spawn" or "Model absent from installed files"
    page()
end

game.on("initialize", page)
game.on("level.ready", function() asset, variants, selected = nil, {}, 1; page() end)
game.on("level.unloading", function()
    -- Handles from the old world have expired; native teardown owns removal.
    asset, variants, waiting = nil, {}, false
    status = "Load a level before using source objects"
    page()
end)
game.on("code.reloaded", inspect)
game.on("save.restored", inspect)

game.on("frame", function()
    if not waiting then return end
    frames = frames + 1
    if frames % 30 ~= 0 then return end
    if not asset then inspect(); return end
    local source = game.assets.source_status()
    status = source.message
    if source.ready then
        waiting = false
        -- Reacquire current handles after loading; disk asset IDs are never
        -- world.spawn handles, and an unloaded template must not be reused.
        definitions()
        status = "Source ready; choose Spawn beside my character"
    elseif source.phase == "failed" or not source.owned then waiting = false end
    page()
end)

game.on("ui.action", function(event)
    if event.page ~= "library" then return end
    if event.row == "inspect" then inspect(); return end
    if not game.world.status().ready then status = "Load a level first"; page(); return end
    if event.row == "previous" and #variants > 0 then selected = (selected - 2) % #variants + 1 end
    if event.row == "next" and #variants > 0 then selected = selected % #variants + 1 end
    local choice = variants[selected]
    if event.row == "load" and choice then
        -- Additions are serialized, and up to eight archives share one native
        -- dependency session. Loading another source keeps our older objects.
        -- Another mod's pending addition can report busy; do not retry per frame.
        local result = game.system.try_call("assets.load_source", {stream = choice.stream})
        waiting = result.ok
        status = result.ok and "Loading original source" or result.error
    elseif event.row == "cancel" then
        local canceled = game.assets.cancel_source()
        waiting = false
        status = canceled and "Addition canceled; earlier sources stay loaded" or "No pending addition to cancel"
    elseif event.row == "spawn" and choice then
        definitions()
        choice = variants[selected]
        local actor = game.players.controlled(event.player)
        if actor and choice and choice.resident_template ~= "" then
            local p = actor.position
            local result = game.system.try_call("world.spawn", {template = choice.resident_template,
                position = {x = p.x + 4, y = p.y + 1, z = p.z}, radius = 1})
            status = result.ok and "Spawned " .. choice.name or result.error
        else status = "Wait for this variant's source to finish loading" end
    elseif event.row == "clear" then
        for _, object in ipairs(game.world.owned()) do game.world.destroy(object.id) end
        game.assets.release_source()
        waiting = false
        status = "My removal requested; other owners keep the source session"
    end
    page()
end)

-- Do not put template or entity handles in game.state. The host transfers
-- supported source claims and owned objects on reload/exact restore. Checkpoint
-- loads start a fresh world. New scenes still need authored placement and AI.

# Scene editor

Modders: start here for a small prop scene using public APIs and the game's
original Options menu. Read the [scene guide](https://github.com/YesterMester/TheSimpsonsGameRecomp/blob/main/modkit/SCENES.md) in the repository
for the complete workflow and supported resources.

Use Modkit's isolated **Test** action, load a level, then open **Options →
Extras → Mods → Scene editor**. Place props, edit their positions, rotate or
resize them, and use undo/redo to revise your scene. This project starts
disabled and keeps your normal playthrough separate.

Choose **Save scene draft** and wait for confirmation. Close Test, choose
**Apply scene draft** in Modkit and review mod.json before exporting.
Enable the episode autoload toggle if your scene should appear automatically
for players. Importing the resulting ZIP preserves your credit and starts
disabled.

The Lua comments explain the important boundaries: original definition GUIDs
and archive paths identify resources; stable object tags identify owned copies;
temporary native handles never enter saved state. Preview rollback removes
only newly created copies. Do not replace these checks with model-name guesses
or stored addresses.

The initial editor supports 64 props in one episode, XYZ movement, yaw,
uniform scaling and 64 session edits of undo/redo. Its document supports full
world matrices. It does not create maps, collision, navigation or complete NPC
encounters. Adapt the commented code for your own project while keeping those
resource and ownership requirements explicit.
